annotations.text:
learnos — one falsifiable promise

Every competitor promises learning. This promises retention, measured: a surprise test on day 30 you might fail.

That single fact drives the whole system. Warm paper and one clay accent so 30 days of daily use never grates; numbers set in mono so digits don't shift as they change; no streaks, badges or confetti anywhere.

The hardest thing to design

We deliberately never teach ~10% of concepts — the control group. Users see them as dashed '?' nodes on their own map.

Unexplained that looks broken, so the map states it plainly: the gap between taught and held-back scores on day 30 is the only honest evidence the teaching worked.

Green and yellow is the worst possible pair

The map leans on exactly the two hues that ~8% of men cannot separate. So state is carried three ways at once: hue, fill level (full / half / hollow / dashed) and a written label. The dot is shorthand, never the only signal.
